description: Unit tests for google_breakpad::MinidumpMemoryRange class, testing memory range operations, subranges, data access, and string extraction.

classes.name: MinidumpMemoryRange
classes.description: Represents a range of memory in a minidump, with methods for subranges and data access.

methods.name: ConstructorWithDataAndLength
methods.description: Initializes MinidumpMemoryRange with provided data pointer and size.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the memory range to empty.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the memory range to new data and size.

methods.name: Subrange
methods.description: Returns a subrange of the current memory range, either by offset/length or by MDLocationDescriptor.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to data at a given offset and length within the range.

methods.name: GetArrayElement
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the array element at a specified index within the range.

methods.name: GetAsciiMDString
methods.description: Extracts an ASCII string from the memory range, given an offset.
